definitions.usage: breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See 5630 .
definitions.full: H8302. shiryon or shiryan שִׁרְיָה noun feminine a weapon, perhaps lance, javelin ; — ׳שׁ Job 41:18 (+ מַסָּע חֲנִית, חֶרֶב, ), — yet ᵐ5 θώρακα , ᵑ7 thorax , i.e. שִׁרְיוֺן . IV. שׁרה (√ of following; meaning dubious; compare Assyrian siriyâm , body-armour (Inscription of Sennacherib), Aramaic id. ; Ecclus 43:20 id. ; also Egyptian ¾u-ïra-na, tà-ra-y-na , WMM As.u.Eur.102 ). שִׁרְיָ֑ן שִׁרְיוֺן, noun [masculine] body-armour ; — absolute שִׁרְיוֺן 1Sam 17:5 , 38 ; שִׁרְיָ֑ן (Ges § 29u ) 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33 , שִׁרְיָ֔ן Isa 59:17 ; plural שִׁרְיֹנִים Neh 4:10 , שִׁרְיֹנוֺת 2Chr 26:14 ; — body-armour , perhaps more exactly breast-armour , Neh 4:10 ; with appendages ( הַדְּבָקִים ) 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33 ; with verb לבשׁ 1Sam 17:5 , made of scale-like plates ( קַשְׂקֵשִּׂים ) of bronze 17:5 , named with helmet here, so 17:38 ; 2Chr 26:14 and (figurative) Isa 59:17 . — ׳שׂ proper name see שׂריון .
definitions.rootNote: or שִׁרְיֹן ; and שִׁרְיָן ; also (feminine) שִׁרְיָה ; and שִׁרְיֹנָה ; from 8281 in the original sense of turning ;
